response.sql:
WITH city_counts AS (
  SELECT c.location AS city, COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) AS race_count
  FROM circuits AS c
  JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM qualifying AS q
    WHERE q.raceId = r.raceId
  )
  GROUP BY c.location
), shares AS (
  SELECT city, race_count,
         1.0 * race_count / SUM(race_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM city_counts
), scored AS (
  SELECT city, race_count, share,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT city, race_count, share, share - average_share AS above_average_share
FROM scored
WHERE share > average_share;

assumptions.assumption: Only cities with at least one race that has qualifying data are included when calculating the average share across cities.
